_meta.description: Quest dialogue for MQ-24: The Siege of Coppervale. Year 2 Winter — multi-day siege climax.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: Scouts report movement in the Scorchlands. Three columns. Infantry, siege equipment, and... mechs. At least two. They'll be here by morning.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: This is it. All defenses to combat readiness. Turrets armed, walls manned, traps active. Everyone knows their station.

lines.speaker: npc_linden
lines.text: I've moved the children and elderly to the shelter beneath Gus's store. Pastor Elm is with them. The rest of us... we stand our ground.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I have calculated optimal turret firing arcs based on the enemy's likely approach vectors. Uploading targeting data now. Jack — your mech is fully fueled and armed. It's ready when you are.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: Listen up, all of you. I've been a soldier my whole life. I've seen towns fall. I've seen walls crumble. I've seen good people die because nobody stood between them and the dark.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: But I have NEVER — not once — seen a town like this one. You built walls out of scrap and held them with spit and stubbornness. You turned a ruin into a home.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: The Marshal thinks strength is about control. About forcing people to obey. But real strength? Real strength is choosing to stand when every part of you wants to run.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: So when those gates shake tomorrow, you remember — you are not alone. You have never been alone. Now get to your posts. And God help any raider who sets foot in our town.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [A cheer rises from the defenders of Coppervale. It echoes off the walls and into the winter night.]

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [Dawn breaks cold and grey. The Iron Marauder army stretches across the eastern horizon — banners of black iron against the snow.]

lines.speaker: the_marshal
lines.text: [Via loudspeaker] Last chance, Coppervale. Send out the engineer and the AI core, and my army walks away. No one else needs to die today.

lines.speaker: npc_spark
lines.text: [From the walls] HEY MARSHAL! I BUILT SOMETHING FOR YOU! IT'S CALLED A TURRET AND IT FIRES REALLY FAST!

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: ...Spark, get behind cover. NOW.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Enemy advance beginning. First wave — light infantry, probing our defenses. Turrets engaging.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: First wave repelled. Minimal damage to the eastern wall. Their sappers tried to breach the south gate — traps caught most of them.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Casualty analysis: enemy lost approximately 40 units. Our turret ammunition is at 78%. Two wall sections sustained structural damage — repair teams are already en route.

lines.speaker: npc_michelle
lines.text: Three wounded so far. Nothing critical. But they're testing us, Jack. The real push hasn't come yet.

lines.speaker: npc_ferris
lines.text: JACK! Radio contact — incoming from the north road! It's... it's the Beacon Towns! They're HERE!

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Alliance reinforcements have arrived. I told you they'd come.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Full deployment. Thornwall militia, Dusthaven supplies and volunteers, Ironridge sappers. Every town sent their best. Your diplomacy paid off, Jack.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: Sixty additional fighters, sapper teams, and enough supplies to last a week. The Marshal wasn't expecting this. Good.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Partial deployment. Some fighters, some supplies. Better than nothing, but we'll need to rely more heavily on our own defenses.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: Thirty fighters and a sapper team. It'll make a difference on the walls, but the mech battle is still on you, Jack.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: ...Nothing. No reinforcements. The Council sent their regrets. They're 'preserving their own defenses.'

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: Then we do this alone. Wouldn't be the first time. Dig in, people. Every shot counts.

lines.speaker: npc_linden
lines.text: Today is Remembrance Day. Even in the middle of a siege... especially in the middle of a siege... we honor those we've lost.

lines.speaker: npc_elm
lines.text: The Marauders have ceased fire for the morning. Even they, it seems, respect the Day. Or perhaps they simply need rest. Either way — we take this moment.

lines.speaker: npc_maren
lines.text: Oren. My Oren. He would have loved to see what Jack built here. He always said this town had a future. He was right.

lines.speaker: npc_pip
lines.text: I lit a lantern for my mom. She... she would've been scared. But she would've stayed. She always stayed.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: ALERT. Seismic sensors detecting heavy footfall. Something large is approaching from the southeast. Very large.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: That's his personal mech. I've seen it in intelligence reports — a modified Heavy class with siege weaponry. He's coming himself.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Jack, get to your mech. This is what we built it for.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Combat Mech Mk II is fully operational. Weapons charged. Jack... be careful. His mech outweighs ours by forty percent.

lines.speaker: the_marshal
lines.text: [Via mech comm] So this is the legendary engineer of Coppervale. I expected someone... bigger.

lines.speaker: the_marshal
lines.text: You know, we're not so different. We both see the broken world and want to fix it. The difference is I understand what it actually costs.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The difference is I don't build my future on other people's ashes.

lines.speaker: the_marshal
lines.text: Noble words. Let's see if they stop a cannon shell.

lines.speaker: the_marshal
lines.text: [Mech systems failing] ...Impressive. Your machine is better than I anticipated. But this changes nothing. I'll be back. With more.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: His mech is withdrawing. Escort units covering his retreat. The remaining Marauder forces are breaking formation — they're falling back!

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: THEY'RE RUNNING! Hold positions — don't pursue! Let them go!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [The last of the Iron Marauder army disappears into the winter snow. Coppervale stands. Battered, scarred, but standing.]

lines.speaker: npc_linden
lines.text: We did it. We actually did it.

lines.speaker: npc_spark
lines.text: The turrets held! The walls held! WE held! Jack, we need to celebrate. Right now. Immediately.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: Celebrate tomorrow. Tonight we count our losses, tend our wounded, and repair what we can. But yes... you should be proud. All of you.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The Marshal escaped. He will rebuild. He will return. But today, Coppervale proved something that no army can undo: that people who choose to stand together cannot be broken.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Jack... thank you. For not surrendering me. For believing I was worth fighting for.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Alright, everyone. Drinks are on the house tonight. ALL of them. Even the good whiskey. We earned it.
